title: KDP Paperback Cover Template Generator
description: Generate a free, print-ready PDF cover template with the exact spine width, bleed, and trim dimensions for your KDP paperback. Enter your page count, trim size, and paper type, then download the template and hand it to your cover designer (or use it yourself).
whatYouCanDo: Download a print-ready cover template sized to your book

title: KDP eBook Cover Guidelines
description: Official Amazon KDP cover artwork specifications for Kindle eBooks, including the recommended image size (2500 x 2500 pixels), aspect ratio, file types, and color space. Use this as your checklist before uploading your cover.
whatYouCanDo: Check your eBook cover meets Amazon's artwork specs

title: Kindle Create
description: Free official desktop app from Amazon that formats your manuscript into a polished Kindle eBook and helps you build a professional cover and interior layout. Download it for Windows or Mac.
whatYouCanDo: Format your manuscript and build a cover in one free app

title: KDP Book Description (Blurb) Help
description: Official KDP guidance on writing your book description, including what to include, the HTML formatting options Amazon supports, and best practices for a blurb that sells. A good blurb hooks readers and explains why your book matters.
whatYouCanDo: Learn how to write a blurb that hooks readers

title: KDP Author Central Author Page
description: Free official Author Central page where you can add your author bio, blog, events, and photos — a companion to your book's blurb that helps readers connect with you and find your other books.
whatYouCanDo: Build a free author page with bio and photos

title: Kindle Store Best Sellers Categories
description: Browse official Amazon Kindle Store best-seller lists by category to see where similar books sit and help you pick the right categories for your title. Good categories help the right readers find your book.
whatYouCanDo: Research categories where similar books sell

title: KDP Categories Help
description: Official KDP help explaining how categories work, how many you can choose, and how to pick categories that fit your book. You can pick up to three categories when you set up your paperback or eBook.
whatYouCanDo: Learn how to choose the right categories

title: KDP Royalty Calculator
description: Official KDP royalty information explaining how royalties are calculated for KDP eBooks (35% and 70% options) and paperbacks (60% royalty, minus printing costs), plus pricing guidance. Use it to estimate what you'll earn per sale.
whatYouCanDo: Estimate your royalty per eBook or paperback sale

title: KDP Paperback Royalty Help
description: Official KDP guidance on paperback royalties, printing costs, distribution channels, and how your earnings are calculated per marketplace. Helpful if you're printing physical copies.
whatYouCanDo: Understand paperback royalties and printing costs

title: Kindle eBook Pricing and Royalty Help
description: Official KDP help on Kindle eBook pricing, royalty options (35% vs 70%), delivery costs, and how to choose the right price for your book. Includes the pricing rules for each royalty tier.
whatYouCanDo: Choose the right eBook price and royalty tier
